scope: All 26 harmonic and 26 price-action directional variants, one exact frozen example each; not every historical occurrence or timeframe.
source_integrity: No detector, specification, source OHLCV or frozen research event changed. Backend change is addition of the previously omitted published harmonic failure level.
limitations: Frozen occurrences only; no certification of profitability, statistical validity, all occurrences or every timeframe.
Small grid charts inspected at the actual desktop viewport, with all candle geometry visible.
HA07 bullish time asymmetry is permitted by the recorded detector rule; correct rendering does not validate that rule.
PA contextual trend metadata was checked for expected direction, not independently refitted from source history.
tests: 53 focused tests passed; 89 passed combined with test_pattern_drawing_accuracy.py

findings.detail: Published confirmation.failure_level was omitted. Rendered verbatim as Failure level and checked against each terminal pivot; no detector or event changed.
Blue levels now explicitly described as projected potential reversal zone (PRZ), rather than leaving their meaning implicit.
Grid headers now distinguish Forming / setup from Confirmed; drawing animation completion does not imply confirmation.

AD/XA can be negative because it is a signed displacement. HA10 constraints do not use AD/XA; omitted from HA10 display only. Both final frontend variants visually rechecked, with exact geometry unchanged.
